title: Loudness normalise and delivery check (ffmpeg)
what_it_does: loudness.py measures and normalises to a LUFS target; check.py tests a finished file against a platform (codec, size, aspect, fps, loudness, length) and reports pass/warn with the numbers.
when_to_use: Last step before upload; catches wrong loudness and format problems.
why: Numbers come from measurement, not guesses; the platform table notes which limits are guidance only.
